info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Regulatory Authorities Retrieval API
info.description: The Regulatory Authorities Retrieval API provides access to detailed information about regulatory authorities related to corporate banking. Users can retrieve specific data regarding various regulatory bodies by utilizing the unique identifier provided in the endpoint. This API is essential for banks, financial institutions, and compliance departments that require up-to-date regulatory information for operational and reporting purposes. It streamlines the process of accessing vital regulatory insights, enabling informed decision-making and ensuring compliance with industry standards.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve detailed information about a specific regulatory authority identified by its unique ID (RES-100045). It provides essential data related to the regulatory authority's roles, responsibilities, and contact information, helping businesses comply with relevant regulations.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving regulatory authority information with identifier RES-100045. This includes necessary parameters to access the relevant corporate relations data.

200.description: Successful retrieval of regulatory authority data.
